CHAPTER XXI: RETENTION OF MONEYS IN CERTAIN PROVIDENT FUNDS

162.
The person having custody of the moneys lying in
any provident fund to the credit of a contributor to such fund
who is liable to income tax on any part of such moneys, shall,
when he makes payment of these moneys to that contributor,
retain in his custody an amount equal to fifteen per centum
of those moneys, other than such part thereof as represents
